content: Official ListenBrainz Python client is liblistenbrainz (metabrainz/liblistenbrainz on GitHub, PyPI). Latest version 0.7.0 (released Feb 23, 2026), requires Python >=3.8, GPLv3, maintained by MetaBrainz Foundation. Core methods: get_listens(username=...), get_playing_now(), submit_single_listen() (write, needs user token). get_listens works unauthenticated for public read; library handles rate limits automatically. Not in Context7 index; verified via PyPI + GitHub README cross-check.
